# SARIF 2.1.0 schema

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the official OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 JSON schema (errata 01), copied unchanged from
https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json on 2026-10-22
(sha256 prefix c3b4bb2d60938974). The SARIF writer's test validates its output against it.
